description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, handling common setup tasks such as initializing logging mechanisms.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base class for activities that sets up a logging framework and provides common functionality for derived activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created; currently only calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity becomes visible; initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain using LogWrapper and logs an initial 'Ready' message.
